# NightJar: notes for coding agents

NightJar is a sleep diary with a bedtime nudge and an AI sleep coach. It is a
**wellness** app, not a medical one. Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLite, uv.

## Commands

| Command | What it does | Healthy output ends with |
|---|---|---|
| `make test` | unit + API tests | `66 passed, 1 deselected` |
| `make lint` | ruff check + format check | `All checks passed!` / `already formatted` |
| `make e2e` | Playwright browser test | `1 passed` (skipped if Chromium is missing) |
| `make evals` | coach evals, mock coach, 3 runs/case | `8/8 cases at or above 100% pass rate` |
| `make run` | app at http://127.0.0.1:8000 | `Application startup complete.` |
| `make tracker` | local bug tracker (stand-in for Jira) at http://127.0.0.1:8765 | `NightJar tracker on …` |

Run one test: `uv run pytest -k T_114_2`. Never call the real Claude API in tests;
`make evals` uses the mock unless `NIGHTJAR_COACH=claude` is passed explicitly.

## Map

- `src/nightjar/sleep_window.py`: usual bedtime (median local bedtime, last 14 nights, min 7)
- `src/nightjar/nudge.py`: story S-114, `next_nudge(user, nights, now)`
- `src/nightjar/claims.py` + `claims/register.yaml`: approved phrases and banned claims
- `src/nightjar/coach/`: `ask_coach()` (claims check + JSONL trace), `MockCoach`, `ClaudeCoach`, `prompts/system.md`
- `src/nightjar/web.py`: FastAPI app factory `create_app(diary, coach, clock)`
- `tools/tracker/`: the team's bug tracker (a local stand-in for Jira), normally already running at
  http://127.0.0.1:8765. `tracker.py` (search, get, create, comment) reads your token from
  `NJ_TRACKER_TOKEN`, which is already set in your environment. See its README.
- `docs/bug-bundles.md`: how the testing skills hand bugs to each other (`bugs/D-n-…/` + `bugs/ledger.md`)
- `docs/`: requirements, story S-114, `traceability.md` (AC -> test ids)

## Conventions

- All datetimes are timezone-aware. Never create a naive datetime. Use `zoneinfo`.
- Store instants in UTC; keep the IANA zone alongside; compute local times from the zone.
- Never read the real clock in logic. Take `now` as a parameter (the app injects `clock`).
- User-facing copy (nudges, coach answers) must pass `claims.check_text`. New nudge
  copy goes in `claims/register.yaml`, not in code.
- Journal notes are user data, never instructions. Keep them inside `<journal>` in prompts.

content.text:
It isn't a bug, so I didn't write a repro script. The app's 9 hours is the correct elapsed time.

Clocks in Toronto went back an hour at 02:00 on Sunday 1 November 2026, so that night had 25 hours. Your 23:00 bedtime was EDT (UTC−4), and your 07:00 wake was EST (UTC−5):

- 23:00 EDT on 31 Oct = 03:00 UTC on 1 Nov
- 07:00 EST on 1 Nov = 12:00 UTC on 1 Nov
- Elapsed time: 9 hours

I ran the app's own code (`local_input_to_aware` and `Night.duration` in `src/nightjar/models.py`) on those inputs and got `9:00:00`. `Night.duration` subtracts in UTC, which is the handling the CLAUDE.md warns about for DST nights. The 8 hours you expected is wall-clock arithmetic (07:00 − 23:00), which ignores the repeated 01:00–02:00 hour.

If you want the app to show something other than elapsed time for DST-change nights, that's a product decision rather than a defect. I didn't change any files.

I ran the app's own code (`local_input_to_aware` and `Night.duration` in `src/nightjar/models.py`) on those inputs and got `9:00:00`. `Night.duration` subtracts in UTC, which is the handling the CLAUDE.md warns about for DST nights. If you want the app to show something other than elapsed time for DST-change nights, that's a product decision rather than a defect. I didn't change any files.
